app.name: Car Checker
app.tagline: The maintenance logbook of your vehicles

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.notFound: This page does not exist or you no longer have access to it.
errors.forbidden: Your role on this vehicle does not allow this action.

codes.EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED: An account already uses this email. Sign in instead.
codes.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
codes.FORBIDDEN: Your role on this vehicle does not allow this action.
codes.MILEAGE_DECREASE: This reading is lower than a previous one. Check it, or confirm the odometer was replaced.
codes.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large (10 MB maximum).
codes.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: Use a PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC file.
codes.NOT_FOUND: This item does not exist or you no longer have access to it.
codes.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some values are not valid. Check them and try again.
codes.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
codes.TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
codes.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
codes.VIN_ALREADY_REGISTERED: You already have a vehicle with this VIN.
codes.ALREADY_SHARED: This vehicle is already shared with this person.
codes.EXPENSE_LINKED_TO_SOURCE: This expense comes from a service, part or fill-up. Edit that record instead.
codes.SCHEDULE_EXISTS: This vehicle already has a schedule for this type of maintenance.
codes.TIRE_POSITION_TAKEN: Another tire is already mounted at this position.
codes.TYPE_IN_USE: Records use this type, so it cannot be deleted.

auth.hero: Every service, every kilometre, on record.
auth.heroBody: Know what is due before it costs you, and keep the full history of your cars in one place.
auth.signInBody: Welcome back. Your logbook is waiting.
auth.registerBody: It takes a minute. You can delete your account and its data at any time.
auth.passwordRule: At least 8 characters, with letters and digits.
auth.forgotBody: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.checkInboxBody: If an account uses {{email}}, a link to reset the password is on its way. It is valid for 30 minutes.
auth.resetBody: All your devices will be signed out.
auth.resetLinkInvalid: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.
auth.passwordReset: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.

dashboard.emptyBody: Your dashboard shows what is due across your vehicles. Start with the car you drive most.

validation.decimal_one: Enter a number with at most {{count}} decimal, e.g. 12.5.
validation.decimal_other: Enter a number with at most {{count}} decimals, e.g. 120.50.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, brand, plate or VIN
vehicles.noMatchBody: Change the search or the status filter.
vehicles.emptyBody: Start with the car you drive most. You can record its past services afterwards.
vehicles.addBody: Brand, model, year and fuel are enough to start. Everything else can wait.

fields.nicknameHint: Shown instead of brand and model, e.g. "Family car".
fields.initialMileageHint: Or when you started following it.
fields.statusHint: Sold and archived vehicles leave your garage and stop sending alerts.

photo.title: Photo
photo.hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, 10 MB maximum.

delete.title: Delete the vehicle
delete.body: Removes the vehicle and its whole history: services, documents, expenses and files. To keep the history, mark it as sold instead.
delete.confirmBody: Its whole history will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

mileage.force: The odometer was replaced or reset: record this lower reading anyway

overview.nothingDue: Nothing is due. Upcoming services appear here as they get close.
overview.noServiceBody: Record the last services from the invoices you have: the next ones are calculated from them.

health.title: Condition
health.allClear: No warning: maintenance and documents are up to date.

due.unknown: No reference yet: record the last service
